title: FINE-TUNING SMALL LANGUAGE MODELS AS EFFICIENT ENTERPRISE SEARCH RELEVANCE LABELERS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating fine-tuned SLM-generated queries against GPT-4o gold-standard judgments and conducting manual analysis to observe the model's inability to generate truly irrelevant (negative) queries, defaulting instead to plausible-sounding or positive queries due to helpfulness optimizations in pretraining.
